name: LeadMagic
description: B2B data enrichment — email finder, mobile finder, and profile & company search.

methods.label: Find Email
methods.description: Find a person's work email from their name and company. Needs a name (first_name+last_name OR full_name) AND a company (domain OR company_name). Returns { email, status, employment_verified, company_name }. 1 credit per valid email; free if not found.

methods.label: Validate Email
methods.description: Validate an email address and return deliverability + company data. Returns { email, email_status, is_domain_catch_all, company_name, company_industry }. 0.25 credit for definitive valid/invalid.

methods.label: Find Mobile
methods.description: Find a person's mobile phone number. Provide at least one of profile_url, work_email, personal_email. Returns { mobile_number, profile_url, email }. 5 credits on success; free if none found.

methods.label: Enrich LinkedIn Profile
methods.description: Enrich a LinkedIn profile from its URL. Returns { full_name, professional_title, bio, location, company_name, company_industry, work_experience[], education[] }. 1 credit on success.

methods.label: Email to LinkedIn Profile
methods.description: Reverse-lookup a LinkedIn profile from a work or personal email. Returns { profile_url }. 10 credits on success; free if no match.

methods.label: Enrich Company
methods.description: Enrich a company from its domain, name, or LinkedIn URL. Returns camelCase fields: { companyName, industry, employeeCount, employeeRange, founded, headquarters, revenue, description, specialties[] }. 1 credit on success.

methods.label: Find Person by Role
methods.description: Find a person holding a given job title at a company. Provide job_title plus company_domain OR company_name. Returns { full_name, profile_url, job_title, company_name }. 2 credits on success.

job_title.description: Target job title, e.g. 'VP of Sales'

methods.label: Detect Job Change
methods.description: Check whether a person has changed jobs from a known company. Provide profile_url plus the expected company_domain OR company_name. Returns { job_changed, still_employed, current_company, current_title }. 3 credits per call.

methods.label: Check Credits
methods.description: Get the current LeadMagic credit balance. Returns { credits }. Free.
